verdict.rationale: The pack mentions 'Built-in Sales Flows', always-on agents ('Deploy AI agents 24/7'), and a community note about setting up a 'timed email'. None of these documents scheduling recurring jobs or workflows: a timed email is a one-off delayed action, and 24/7 agents are not a recurring schedule. With no evidence of the capability itself, the verdict is none.
